meta.name: sandbox-next
meta.description: Build or maintain Cloudflare Sandbox apps on @cloudflare/sandbox@next (SDK 1.0 preview). Use sandbox-migrate-to-next when porting a stable app.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建或维护基于新版 SDK 的 Cloudflare 沙盒应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在用预览版 SDK 开发或维护 Cloudflare 沙盒应用。
copy.tagline_en: Build or maintain Cloudflare Sandbox apps using the preview SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building or maintaining Cloudflare Sandbox apps on the preview SDK.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在做 Cloudflare Sandbox 应用时,会先确认依赖和镜像是否属于 @cloudflare/sandbox@next(1.0 预览)线,若是,则按该 SDK 的 API 规则实现(进程启动返回句柄、无隐式 shell),并先查文档再写码。
howto.when: 当你想基于 @cloudflare/sandbox@next(1.0 预览)新建或维护 Cloudflare Sandbox 应用时;若发现项目用的是稳定版或要从稳定版移植,它会改用 sandbox-stable 或 sandbox-migrate-to-next。

say.text: 检查一下这个项目的 sandbox 是否在用 @next 预览版。
say.note: 它会核验 npm 依赖和容器镜像,不符会停止并改走其他技能。

say.text: 给沙箱加一个执行 Python 的进程,用 @next API 实现。
say.note: 它会用 exec 返回句柄的方式实现,并按文档核对写法。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude verifies dependency/image are on @cloudflare/sandbox@next (1.0 preview) before coding. It follows that SDK's API rules (exec returns a handle, no implicit shell) and consults official docs first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build or maintain a Cloudflare Sandbox app on @cloudflare/sandbox@next (1.0 preview). If dependency is stable or you ask to port, it routes to sandbox-stable or sandbox-migrate-to-next.

say_en.text: Create a Cloudflare Workers sandbox app using @cloudflare/sandbox@next.
say_en.note: It verifies the dependency and image line, then scaffolds.

say_en.text: Check if this project's sandbox dependencies are on the @next preview.
say_en.note: It inspects npm dependency and image; stops if not @next.

say_en.text: Add a Python execution process to this sandbox with the @next API.
say_en.note: It uses the exec-handle approach and checks docs for exact signatures.
